name: Fukashigi Denshou ~Kabara no Himitsu~
original_name: 不可思議伝承 ～カバラの秘密～
source:
The story is of the village of Syria close to Greece at the time when the German army invasion approaches in 1941. This work's motif is the search of holy grail and occult research performed by the Germany.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在1941年。德军步步逼近，舞台则是希腊附近的叙利亚村。本作以寻找圣杯以及德国开展的神秘学研究为主题。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
